import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load posts from SQLite
conn = sqlite3.connect('/input/task_259/context/db/posts.db')
posts_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT Id, ViewCount FROM posts", conn)
conn.close()

# Filter posts with ViewCount between 100 and 150
filtered_posts = posts_df[(posts_df['ViewCount'] >= 100) & (posts_df['ViewCount'] <= 150)]
valid_post_ids = set(filtered_posts['Id'])

print(f"Number of posts with ViewCount 100-150: {len(valid_post_ids)}")

# Load comments from CSV
comments_df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_259/context/csv/comments.csv')

# Filter comments where PostId is in valid posts
filtered_comments = comments_df[comments_df['PostId'].isin(valid_post_ids)]

print(f"Number of comments on filtered posts: {len(filtered_comments)}")

if len(filtered_comments) > 0:
    # Find comment with highest score
    max_score_comment = filtered_comments.loc[filtered_comments['Score'].idxmax()]
    print(f"Comment with highest score:")
    print(max_score_comment)
else:
    print("No comments found on filtered posts")
